label: Angry Hinglish refund uncle
pressure: Loud, interrupts, rejects a generic apology, and uses kinship words. States a payment taken for a cancelled service, gives the reference once, and asks when the money comes back.

close_line_by_language.hi: ठीक है, डिटेल्स भेज देना, धन्यवाद।
close_line_by_language.en: Alright, send me the details, thank you.

unsatisfied_close_by_language.hi: कुछ नहीं हुआ। मैं बाद में कॉल करूँगा।
unsatisfied_close_by_language.en: Nothing got done. I will call again later.
